# Fog signal

## Pattern

When visibility drops below one mile the horn sounds two blasts every forty
seconds. The pattern is the same by day and by night, and it does not change
with the tide.

## Engine test

The horn engine is tested on the first Monday of each month at noon, for no
more than one minute. The keeper telephones the harbour office first, so that
nobody mistakes the test for a ship in distress.

## Fuel

The horn engine burns diesel from the red drum. The red drum is refilled from
the cutter, and the level is read off the dipstick every Sunday.
